import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Approximate location of El Escondido area near Ensenada, Baja California
fire_location = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.71, 31.84]) # Coords for El Escondido, Ensenada

# The question asks for a future date and time
start_date = '2025-01-23T13:44:00' # January 23, 2025, 1:44 pm local time (PST -8, so 21:44 UTC)
end_date = '2025-01-23T23:59:59' # End of the day UTC to ensure we cover the specific time requested

# 2. Data Acquisition & Check
# Attempt to get Sentinel-2 imagery for visible smoke detection
# Note: This collection is for optical imagery. For smoke, atmospheric
# collections like Sentinel-5P (for aerosol index) could also be relevant,
# but the core issue of a future date applies to all real-time collections.
collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(fire_location) \
    .filterDate(start_date, end_date)

col_size = collection.size().getInfo()

# 3. Validation & Final Answer
if col_size == 0:
    print(f"No satellite images found for the specified date ({start_date} to {end_date}).")
